originality.rationale: The assessed finite-positive-h joint theorem identifies an exact h-independent physical-time current and strictly increasing step-dependent entropy production for this precise stochastically rounded Euler kernel. Han et al. already imply its continuous-time current after a parameter mapping, which is acknowledged; neither their CT generator nor other inspected sources specifies the finite-h simultaneous-flip transition or both exact finite-h laws. No stronger covering finite-step claim found in targeted results; residual specialized-priority risk remains.
residual_risks: A general formula in earlier nonreversible probabilistic cellular automata might specialize to this four-corner Euler step and make parts of its finite-h theorem previously implied.
Known Han et al. two-spin formula covers the limit, so originality is confined to the exact finite-h numerical method identity and finite-h entropy variation.

value.rationale: A natural one-round Euler+unbiased stochastic nearest-rounding discretization of a contracting chiral 2D linear flow shows a precise separation: step-invariant physical-time probability current vs strictly step-increasing physical-time entropy production while stationary law and mean contraction are fixed. This exact discretization behavior is not a generic trivial slogan of unbiasedness; it clarifies long-time sampling fidelity and entropy costs. The 4-state benchmark is motivated by the minimal closed rounding cell and captures simultaneous coordinate flips. No overclaim about arbitrary floating-point.
